priorComponentReview.scope: stock Node autostart suppression and fixed mozlog reader

implementation.sourceAndFixtures: 18 pinned Runtime source files and four fixture files are verified before and after cases. The fixed positive tests actual JavaScript compiled DEBUG, AppConstants.DEBUG and version 158.0.1; negative names a deliberate Assert failure; upstream comparator keeps its original manifest/head.
implementation.builtAssets: Require current task obj-root-contained executable xpcshell and XUL, freshness after the current job origin, x86_64 Mach-O types/UUIDs and per-case post hashes. Darwin bundle path agrees with the pinned get_binary_path implementation.
implementation.selectionAndRetry: Each case uses the real mach xpcshell-test with verbose, sequential, threads 1, explicit manifest and one absolute test file. Only the MOZ_AUTOMATION key is removed from a copy of the clean child environment to prevent stock retry. No dump-tests, failure-to-pass or crash/timeout masking option is used.
implementation.serverScope: Set the existing MOZ_ASSUME_NODE_RUNNING switch to 1 and reject inherited HTTP2/Node port or switch values. No detached HTTP2 server is started or qualified. Stock HTTP3 and selected xpcshell children inherit the monitored stage group; network coverage is explicitly false.
implementation.childRunnerBoundary: Each case gets a separate Runner with the same job monotonic/time origin, limits, 360-minute platform ceiling and existing phase deadline. Raw JSONL is under that case native-private directory, which the unchanged Runner monitors against existing private-data bounds.
implementation.expectedNegative: Require real harness exit 1, exact leader reap with that exit, nonzero-exit at wait, verified group gone, clean cleanup and no stopping monitor failure plus one matching unexpected FAIL lifecycle. Keep child runnerFailure and harness.status failed; never clear or mutate a prior parent failure.
implementation.failureEvidence: Attach the mutable case result before setup. Outer finally retains safe process/stage/first-failure evidence, latest 16 monitor diagnostics and the separate stopping detail. Raw child records/errors are private only. Setup, reader, collection and receipt-write failures leave attached failed evidence and do not become a satisfied control.
implementation.publicProjection: Fixed key/type/enum projections strip IDs/tags/paths at nested monitor/query/cleanup levels. Unknown counters remain null; unknown Failure strings and exception class names map to fixed public fallbacks. Case receipt privateEvidence/privateErrors are not returned to the public caller.
implementation.pipelineScope: --mozilla-only is consumer-only and incompatible with restore-only. It runs after successful resumed full build and current host object validation, before stage-package/native. Success is mozilla-ready with separate qualification and package/native NOT_TESTED, rather than general native-validation passed.
implementation.monitorClassification: A stopping monitor failure in the nested Mozilla case makes validationOutcome execution monitor-inconclusive; it does not establish a product failure.

resolvedFindings.title: DEBUG marker not bound to active selected test
resolvedFindings.resolution: Exact INFO marker requires in-suite and one active expected test, with any explicit row test matching it. Out-of-lifecycle, foreign-ID and ambiguous-active markers are ignored and fail the required marker check.

resolvedFindings.title: Per-case monitor and cleanup evidence lost on setup or persistence failures
resolvedFindings.resolution: Caller preattaches the case dictionary; outer finally retains safe first failure/process/stages/latest16/stopping monitor evidence, and private raw evidence is saved separately. Invalid/failed evidence cannot satisfy a case.

resolvedFindings.title: Arbitrary Failure strings and exception class names entered public error fields
resolvedFindings.resolution: error_code allows only known Runner/module literal Failure codes and fixed exception type names; unknown strings/classes become runner-failure or exception while original text stays private.

negativeControls: Original four debug-marker false positives now reject
Setup failure retains attached case and unknown process
Monitor stop plus receipt-write failure retains original child failure and separate stop detail
Twenty samples retain latest16 plus independent earlier stop
Reader/projection exception retains child cleanup and private evidence
Expected negative with unverified cleanup never satisfies control
Existing parent first failure is not cleared
Existing case receipt is not overwritten on rejected setup
Unknown child/setup Failure text and arbitrary collection/writer class names never enter public result
Mozilla case/config/proof failure blocks qualified pipeline status
Mozilla never runs after full-build failure; restore-only combination rejected
independentValidation.controlsNotClaimed: Driver and pipeline fault controls use deterministic Runner/Mach doubles or tiny files; they are not actual compiled Mozilla execution, a load test or native authentication evidence.
independentValidation.fullRegression: The final complete regression run after these fixes remains a separate required result; an earlier pre-fix full-suite pass is not used to qualify final source.

remainingGates: Complete the final regression run against these exact bytes.
Independently bind any new immutable fixture/caller and exact explicit manifest/test selection before execution.

Actual Mac must verify produced xpcshell/XUL identities, compiled DEBUG/version positive, exact deliberate failure, unmodified upstream comparator, real exit status, complete mozlog lifecycle and owned resource/cleanup evidence.
Keep resumed cross-run provenance, current job/origin separation and all existing SDK/artifact/restore guards.
